rapport_notes: Patient and clear working through the customer's math questions on pricing.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Is there any questions or concerns that you have specifically for this move that you'd like answered on this call?" — asked right after quid pro quo, before any logistics questions.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said "None right now, maybe after we talk a little bit" — no concern raised to dig into.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "You said you're gonna take some of those boxes and things over yourself... that will help keep our time down... less time we take less money you end up spending" — self-prep tip present.

top_strength: Clean full quid pro quo framing right up front, and patiently walked the customer through his own hand-math on the hourly rate.
coaching_note: Damage coverage, meet-your-mover, and on-time guarantee are never mentioned anywhere in the call — a full miss on Stage 1/2 differentiators.
